differences.what: Product scale: in B the speaker fills about 75% of the frame height and reads as the hero; in A it sits small in a large empty sweep, so the colour switch is less impactful and the internals read less clearly
Interior detail (crossover board, port tubes, terminal block, woofer surround) resolves more crisply in B thanks to the larger scale; in A the same parts are soft at frame size

Clear/white colourway: the horn's clear shell almost disappears against the white sweep in both, but in B its top edge is cropped close to the frame top, and the inner throat floats; A keeps more headroom around the horn
Coloured caustic spill on the floor (red, orange, blue) is a little cleaner and more contained in B; in A it streaks further to the left of the product and reads as a light leak
Black colourway: the dark body loses edges against the ground in both; B's larger scale keeps the side handle and panel edges readable, while A's goes to a near-silhouette
